User Story

 

As a system user

I want to be able to calculate invoice through the manual invoice

So that I will have possibility to generate an invoice correctly

 

Acceptance criteria:

  1. While user has created Manual Invoice type of billing run in the system, it means that only one invoice should be created according to the defined values

  2. When user created Manual Invoice type of billing run in the system, invoice according to the billing run should be calculated according to the following logic:

    1. On the Summary Data tab should indicate two manually filled columns:

      1. VAT rate

      2. Value

    2. Firstly should indicate if there are different types of VAT rates selected for the billing run.

      1. If there is one type of VAT rate selected in the column, system should sum all the values and display them in the invoice

      2. If there are more than one VAT rates selected in the column, it is mandatory to divide them and sum values accordingly

        1. For example, there are VAT rate 1 and VAT rate 2 are added in the different columns and for the VAT rate 1 there are 3 three columns filled with values: 50, 100 and 200. And for the VAT rate 2 two columns are filled with the values: 150 and 300.

        2. In this case: for the VAT rate 1 there will be summed value: 350 and for the VAT rate 2 there will be summed value: 450 and in the invoice their sum should be displayed as total value: which will be 800

      3. In the invoice system should display different VAT rates with stages with the same logic as we have in the standard invoice creation:

        1. For example, there are three different VAT rates added in the manual invoice, in the invoice should display three different stages with the fields:

          1. Stage 1:

            1. VAT rate, % - for the first VAT rate defined percentage value

            2. Amount excluding VAT - summed value of the VAT according to the Summary Data tab

            3. Value of VAT - calculated value of the amount and VAT rate %

          2. Stage 2:

            1. VAT rate, % - for the second VAT rate defined percentage value

            2. Amount excluding VAT - summed value of the VAT according to the Summary Data tab

            3. Value of VAT - calculated value of the amount and VAT rate %

          3. Stage 3:

            1. VAT rate, % - for the third VAT rate defined percentage value

            2. Amount excluding VAT - summed value of the VAT according to the Summary Data tab

            3. Value of VAT - calculated value of the amount and VAT rate %

          4. Total amount excluding VAT - in this field system should set sum of Amount excluding VAT of all stages

          5. Total amount of VAT - in this field system should set sum of Value of VAT of all staged

          6. Total amount including VAT - in this field system should set sum of Total amount excluding VAT and Total amount of VAT

          7. Total amount including VAT in other currency - in this filed system should set value of Total Amount including VAT calculated in another currency, for example, in Euros

    3. All other data defined in the billing run should be set in the invoice accordingly

Invoice

Billing run

Number (Prefix + Number )

  1. Prefix

    1. Prefix field is filled automatically by Contract/Order

    2. If in the billing run the Contract/Order sub object is the Product, the Invoice should be take n the prefix “ Ð¤Ð°ÐºÑÑÑÐ° Ð·Ð° Ð¿ÑÐ¾Ð´ÑÐºÑ (Product invoice)” from the nomenclature

    3. If the billing run is the “Service contract” or “Service/Good order” the invoice should be taken the prefix “Ð¤Ð°ÐºÑÑÑÐ° Ð·Ð° ÑÑÐ»ÑÐ³Ð°/ÑÑÐ¾ÐºÐ° (Service/goods invoice)”

    4. Prefix is created by contract/order, if the contract/order is not added ( its optional ) prefix should be generated by Prefix type radio buttons .

Date

Invoice date

Status

  1. If the manual invoice

  2. With three available hardcoded values:

    1. Draft

    2. Real

    3. Cancelled

  3. System should automatically set relevant status for the document

Document Type

-

tax event date

Tax event date

Invoice type

Billing Type

Payment deadline

Invoice due date

  1. Payment deadline is defined according to the chosen Invoice Due Date in the billing run

    1. If 'According to contract' option is selected, it means that system should calculate the payment deadline according to the Payment Term in terms object

      1. If there are several payment terms added to the terms, it is mandatory to choose one option in the contract, so system should calculate payment deadline according to the chosen payment term in the contract

      2. Calculated payment deadline = Invoice date + defined configuration in the payment terms

        1. For example: if invoice date is 1st of December 2023 and in the payment terms 2 working days are selected, it means that the payment deadline for this invoice should be 5th of December 2023

    2. If 'Date' option is selected, it means that there will be a defined date in the billing run which should be set automatically in the invoice

  2. If the contract/order is not added in the billing run , the “According to the contract” radio button should be disabled

Meter reading period from

Automatically set according to the minimum data of the Billing data on which bases the invoice was made

Meter reading period to

Automatically set according to the maximum data of the Billing data on which bases the invoice was made

Basis for issuing

Basis for issuing

Number of income account

Number of income account

The “manual” checkbox is not selected and added sub object is the “Contract”/Service order, the “Number of income account” should be taken from Product/Service. (This field is mandatory in the Product/Service)
If the added sub object is the “Good Order”, the Number of income account should be taken from Goods order, if the field is not added in the Goods Order, the field should be taken from Goods, if in the all above object the “Number of income account “ is empty(Its optional) , the field on the Invoice will remain empty.

if the “Manual” checkbox is selected, in this cases the system user should add “Number of income account” manually

If the contract/order sub object is not added the “Manual” checkbox of this field should be checked automatically and the system user should add it manually

Cost center/Controlling order

Cost center/Controlling order

The “manual” checkbox is not selected and the Contract/Order sub object is added. If added sub object is the “Contract”/Service order, the “Cost center/Controlling order” should be taken from Product/Service.(This field is mandatory in the Product/Service)
If the added sub object is the “Good Order”, the “Cost center/Controlling order” should be taken from Goods order, if the field is not added in the Goods Order, the field should be taken from Goods, if in the all above object the “Cost center/Controlling order “ is empty(Its optional) , the field on the Invoice will remain empty.

The “Manual” checkbox is selected, in this cases the system user should add “Cost center/Controlling order” manually

If the contract/order sub object is not added the “Manual” checkbox of this field should be checked automatically and the system user should add it manually

Vat Rate

Vat rate

The “manual” checkbox is not selected and the Contract/Order sub object is added. If added sub object is the “Contract/Service order”, the “VAT rate” should be taken from Product/Service.(This field is mandatory in the Product/Service)
If the added sub object is the “Good Order”, the “VAT rate” should be taken from Goods order. (VAT rate is mandatory in the goods order)

The “Manual” checkbox is selected, in this cases the system user should add “VAT rate” manually

If the contract/order sub object is not added the “Manual” checkbox of this field should be checked automatically and the system user should add it manually

Applicable interest rate

Applicable interest rate

The “manual” checkbox is not selected and the “Contract/Order” sub-object is added, the “Applicable interest rate” should be taken from Contract/Order.

If the contract/order sub object is not added the “Manual” checkbox of this field should be checked automatically and the system user should add it manually

Bank

Bank

The “manual” checkbox is not selected. if added sub object is product contract and billing group sub object is added too, take the "Bank" from billing group sub object, otherwise take the bank directly from Product/service contract or Service/Goods order added in sub-object, even if the “Bank” has not been added to the Contract/Order. The field should be added from the Customer, if none of the above objects provide the bank details, the field on the Invoice will remain empty.


If the Manual checkbox is not selected and Contract/Order is not added(its optional) , the “Bank” fill should be filled from Customer (Customer sub object is mandatory)

If the manual and direct debit checkboxes are selected, the system user should manually add the “Bank”

BIC

Bank account

Sub Object

 

Customer

Customer ( UIC/PN/PN of foreigner + version of the customer )

Contract/Order

Contract/Order , its optional so it can be empty in the invoice

Billing group

Billing group, available after adding contract in the sub object and mandatory to add at least one

Recipients of invoice

Billing group alternative/Customer

Communication data for billing

Invoice communication data

Product /Service

From the Contract/Order which is added in the sub object

Template

Invoice template ID

Issuer

Issuer (Company details)
